ugatuzi.translation: Kenya introduced devolution through a new constitution.

ugatuzi.text: Ugatuzi huzipa kaunti mamlaka ya kusimamia hospitali.
ugatuzi.translation: Devolution gives counties the authority to manage hospitals.

watekaji.translation: The police arrested the hijacker of the bus.

watekaji.text: Watekaji wa ndege walikamatwa na polisi.
watekaji.translation: The hijackers of the plane were arrested by the police.

firauni.text: Firauni alijenga kaburi kubwa la mawe.
firauni.translation: The pharaoh built a large tomb of stone.

firauni.text: Mwalimu wa historia alisimulia kuhusu firauni.
firauni.translation: The history teacher told us about the pharaoh.

iftar.translation: The family gathers to eat iftar in the evening.

iftar.text: Tulialikwa kwa iftar nyumbani kwa jirani.
iftar.translation: We were invited to iftar at the neighbour's house.

ugumba.translation: The doctor explained the causes of infertility.

ugumba.text: Wenzi wengine hutafuta matibabu ya ugumba.
ugumba.translation: Some couples look for treatment for infertility.

upagani.translation: The book describes paganism of the past.

upagani.text: Upagani ulikuwepo kabla ya dini mpya kufika.
upagani.translation: Paganism existed before the new religions arrived.

Kanada.text: Kaka yangu anasoma chuo kikuu nchini Kanada.
Kanada.translation: My brother studies at a university in Canada.
Canada is a very cold country.

ekaristi.translation: The faithful receive the Eucharist at church on Sunday.
The priest led the Eucharist in the morning.

kuungama.translation: He went to church to confess his sins.
Do you want to confess today?

Barbados.text: Barbados ni kisiwa kidogo chenye fuo nzuri.
Barbados.translation: Barbados is a small island with beautiful beaches.

Barbados.text: Wageni wengi hutembelea Barbados wakati wa baridi.
Barbados.translation: Many visitors go to Barbados in the cold season.

maulamaa.text: Maulamaa walikutana msikitini kujadili swali hilo.
maulamaa.translation: The scholars met at the mosque to discuss that question.
The religious scholars teach religion to the believers.

tohara.translation: The child was taken to hospital for circumcision.
The parents asked the doctor about circumcision.

mnafiki.text: Mnafiki husema jambo moja na kufanya jingine.
mnafiki.translation: A hypocrite says one thing and does another.
People called him a hypocrite when he broke his promise.

waongofu.text: Babu yetu alikuwa mwongofu na mwenye heshima.
waongofu.translation: Our grandfather was an upright and respectful man.

waongofu.text: Kijiji kina waongofu wengi wanaosaidia jirani.
waongofu.translation: The village has many upright people who help their neighbours.

mzimu.text: Wazee wanasimulia hadithi ya mzimu msituni.
mzimu.translation: The elders tell a story about a ghost in the forest.

mzimu.text: Kijiji chetu kina mzimu wa zamani karibu na mti mkubwa.
mzimu.translation: Our village has an old shrine near a big tree.

Swaziland.text: Rafiki yangu alisafiri kwenda Swaziland kwa basi.
Swaziland.translation: My friend travelled to Swaziland by bus.

jehanamu.text: Kitabu cha dini kinaeleza kuhusu jehanamu.
Mchungaji alizungumza kuhusu jehanamu kanisani jana.
jehanamu.translation: The pastor spoke about hell at church yesterday.

ufanyaji.text: Ufanyaji wake wa kazi ni wa haraka.
ufanyaji.translation: His way of doing the work is fast.

ufanyaji.text: Mwalimu alieleza ufanyaji wa jaribio hili darasani.
ufanyaji.translation: The teacher explained how this experiment is done in class.

ufyatuaji.text: Ufyatuaji wa risasi ni marufuku mjini.
ufyatuaji.translation: Firing guns is forbidden in town.

ufyatuaji.text: Askari walifanya mazoezi ya ufyatuaji wa risasi asubuhi.
ufyatuaji.translation: The soldiers did shooting practice in the morning.

komuniyo.text: Waumini hupokea komuniyo kanisani kila Jumapili.
komuniyo.translation: Worshippers receive Holy Communion at church every Sunday.

komuniyo.text: Watoto walijiandaa kupokea komuniyo ya kwanza.
komuniyo.translation: The children prepared to receive their first Holy Communion.

walimwengu.text: Mlimwengu yeyote anahitaji chakula na maji.
walimwengu.translation: Every mortal needs food and water.

walimwengu.text: Sisi sote ni walimwengu tunaoishi duniani.
walimwengu.translation: We are all mortals living in this world.

kuondokea.translation: We want to be rid of poverty in Tanzania.

kuondokea.text: Alifanya mazoezi ili kuondokea hofu yake.
kuondokea.translation: He practised so as to overcome his fear.

mchochezi.translation: The police arrested the agitator at the meeting.

mchochezi.text: Mchochezi ni mtu anayechochea ugomvi kati ya watu.
mchochezi.translation: An agitator is a person who stirs up quarrels between people.

monasteri.translation: The nuns live in that monastery.
The tourists visited that monastery yesterday.

uapisho.text: Uapisho wa rais mpya ulifanyika jana.
uapisho.translation: The swearing-in of the new president took place yesterday.

uapisho.text: Watu wengi walitazama uapisho wa mawaziri kwenye televisheni.
uapisho.translation: Many people watched the swearing-in of the ministers on television.

uchungaji.translation: His father studied pastoral work at college.

uchungaji.text: Uchungaji ni kazi ya kuongoza waumini kanisani.
uchungaji.translation: Pastoral work is the job of guiding the congregation at church.

ukasisi.translation: My brother is studying for the priesthood.

ukasisi.text: Ukasisi ni wito wa kuhudumia kanisa.
ukasisi.translation: The priesthood is a calling to serve the church.

ukraini.translation: The teacher showed us Ukraine on the map.

yayo.translation: Give me those two mangoes, please.
Have those eggs been cooked today?

yayo.text: Madirisha yayo yamefungwa kwa sababu ya baridi.
yayo.translation: Those windows are closed because of the cold.

yayo.text: Nipe maembe yayo pale mezani, tafadhali.
yayo.translation: Give me those mangoes there on the table, please.

yayo.text: Mayai yayo yalinunuliwa sokoni jana asubuhi.
yayo.translation: Those eggs were bought at the market yesterday morning.

Estonia.text: Estonia ni nchi ndogo ya Ulaya.
Estonia.translation: Estonia is a small country in Europe.
My teacher was born in Estonia.

Gini.text: Tulisoma kuhusu nchi ya Gini darasani.
Gini.translation: We learned about the country of Guinea in class.

Gini.text: Rafiki yangu anatoka nchi ya Gini.
Gini.translation: My friend comes from the country of Guinea.

Moldova.text: Moldova ni nchi ndogo barani Ulaya.
Moldova.translation: Moldova is a small country in Europe.
Have you ever heard about Moldova?

altare.text: Kuhani aliweka mishumaa juu ya altare.
altare.translation: The priest put candles on the altar.

altare.text: Maua yalipangwa mbele ya altare kanisani.
altare.translation: Flowers were arranged in front of the altar in the church.

Guatemala.translation: A lot of coffee comes from Guatemala.

Guatemala.text: Dada yangu anataka kusafiri hadi Guatemala.
Guatemala.translation: My sister wants to travel to Guatemala.

jumuisho.translation: The teacher talked about inclusion in class.

jumuisho.text: Familia yetu huonyesha jumuisho wakati wa sikukuu.
jumuisho.translation: Our family shows togetherness during holidays.

Madagaska.translation: Madagascar is a big island in the sea.
Lemurs are found only in Madagascar.

kubatiza.translation: The priest will baptize the child at church on Sunday.
Why do they baptize young babies?

sufii.text: Masufii hao husoma mashairi ya kiroho.
Je, unamjua sufii yeyote hapa mjini?
sufii.translation: Do you know any Sufi here in town?

Belarusi.text: Mwanafunzi mmoja darasani kwetu anatoka Belarusi.
Belarusi.translation: One student in our class comes from Belarus.

mpagani.text: Kitabu cha historia kinaeleza maisha ya wapagani wa zamani.
mpagani.translation: The history book describes the lives of pagans of long ago.

mpagani.text: Mpagani alikaribishwa kwenye harusi ya jirani yake.
mpagani.translation: The pagan was welcomed at his neighbour's wedding.

mzambia.translation: A Zambian bought fish at the market.
Our new teacher is a Zambian.

jahanamu.translation: The preacher read a verse about hell.
The student asked what hell is.

thawabu.text: Waumini wanaamini kufunga Ramadhani kuna thawabu.
thawabu.translation: Believers hold that fasting during Ramadan brings spiritual reward.

thawabu.text: Watu wengi hutafuta thawabu kwa kuwasaidia maskini.
thawabu.translation: Many people seek spiritual reward by helping the poor.

theolojia.translation: My brother is studying theology at college.

theolojia.text: Chuo hicho kina kitivo cha theolojia.
theolojia.translation: That college has a faculty of theology.

ubatizo.translation: The child's baptism will take place on Sunday.
The whole family was invited to the baptism.

madrasa.text: Watoto huenda madrasa baada ya shule.
madrasa.translation: The children go to madrasa after school.

uhindu.text: Uhindu ni dini ya zamani sana.
uhindu.translation: Hinduism is a very old religion.

uhindu.text: Mwalimu alieleza historia ya uhindu darasani.
uhindu.translation: The teacher explained the history of Hinduism in class.

upadre.text: Kaka yake alijiunga na upadre mwaka jana.
upadre.translation: His brother entered the priesthood last year.

upadre.text: Upadre unahitaji miaka mingi ya masomo.
upadre.translation: The priesthood requires many years of study.

uterasi.text: Uterasi ni sehemu ya mwili wa mwanamke.
uterasi.translation: The uterus is a part of a woman's body.

uterasi.text: Daktari alieleza kazi ya uterasi darasani.
uterasi.translation: The doctor explained the function of the uterus in class.

yamini.translation: The witness took an oath in court.
The judge asked the witness to take the oath.

siku.translation: Today is a very nice day.

kuu.text: Barabara kuu inapita karibu na shule yetu.
kuu.translation: The main road passes near our school.

kuona.translation: I can see a bird on top of the tree.

kweli.text: Je, ni kweli kwamba kesho hakuna shule?
kweli.translation: Is it true that there is no school tomorrow?

kusafiri.text: Kesho tutasafiri kwa basi hadi kijijini.
kusafiri.translation: Tomorrow we will travel by bus to the village.

mboga.text: Mama anapika wali na mboga jikoni.
mboga.translation: Mama is cooking rice and vegetables in the kitchen.

mchana.text: Mchana huu jua ni kali sana.
mchana.translation: This afternoon the sun is very hot.

mkate.translation: In the morning I ate bread with tea.

kuimba.translation: The children are singing a nice song in class.

titi.text: Mtoto mchanga hunyonya titi la mama yake.
titi.translation: A newborn baby suckles at its mother's breast.

titi.text: Mama ana maumivu kwenye titi lake, kwa hiyo ataenda hospitali.
titi.translation: Mother has pain in her breast, so she will go to the hospital.
